newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Dolenjska bank 9-mth profit up 44 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Dolenjska bank 9-mth profit up 44 pct.

text.p: Slovenia's listed Dolenjska banka said on Friday its pre-tax profit in the first nine months of 1996 rose to 441 million tolars ($3.2 million) from 306 million in the same period a year ago.
Balance sheet assets rose to 50 billion tolars, up 18 percent compared to the end of 1995.
"Our market share rose from 2.6 percent at the beginning of the year to over three percent at the end of September," Dular said.
She said the bank expected the balance sheet at the end of 1996 to be 31 percent higher than at the end of last year.
"We have had some merger talks with other banks because we would like to become even bigger, but that is all I can say for now," she added.
